SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '50' AND q.own_code = '0' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many design patent applications has the USPTO received?
SELECT count(*) AS design_applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE invention_type = 'DES'
In which states did a 40-year-old pay the most for marketplace health insurance in 2021?

SELECT statecode, avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)) AS avg_monthly_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021' AND age = '40' AND tobacco <> 'Tobacco User' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a vaginal delivery cost on average in New York hospital charges in 2016?
SELECT avg(try_cast(total_charges AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND apr_drg_description LIKE 'Vaginal delivery%'
Which congressional candidates spent the most in the 2010 cycle?
SELECT can_nam, sum(try_cast(dis_amo AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.candidate_disbursement WHERE ele_yea = '2010' AND can_nam IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Democratic or Republican House candidates win more votes nationwide in 2022?

SELECT party, sum(try_cast(candidatevotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_house_returns WHERE stage = 'GEN' AND year = '2022' AND party IN ('DEMOCRAT', 'REPUBLICAN') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
Which states have the most incorporated places?
SELECT usps AS state, count(DISTINCT geoid) AS places FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_place WHERE funcstat = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the Airport and Airway Trust Fund take in during fiscal 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS receipts FROM govblock_treasury.airport_airway_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc = 'Receipts'
Which New York ZIP codes reported the most total income on tax returns for 2021?
Income by ZIP Code and County

SELECT zipcode, sum(try_cast(a00100 AS double)) AS agi_thousands FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE state = 'NY' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%' AND zipcode NOT IN ('00000', '99999') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many quantum physics papers were first posted to arXiv in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE primary_category = 'quant-ph' AND substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) = '2023'
Which natural gas storage fields hold the most working gas?
SELECT name, try_cast(workcap AS double) AS working_gas_mcf FROM govblock_siting.hifld_natural_gas_storage_facilities WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many software developers work in the United States, and what do they earn?
SELECT occ_title, tot_emp, a_median FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE area_title = 'U.S.' AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' AND occ_title = 'Software Developers' LIMIT 5
Which counties have the most HUD-subsidized housing units?
SELECT name, states, max(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many New Yorkers aged 70 or older were hospitalised for sepsis in 2016?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND (age_group = '70 or Older' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Septicemia%')
Which courts have the most dockets in the archive?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS dockets FROM govblock_courts.dockets AS d JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = d.court_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of GAO reports in the library change from 2005 to 2020?
SELECT substr(date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND substr(date, 1, 4) IN ('2005', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which antipsychotic drugs are prescribed most under Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT brnd_name, try_cast(tot_clms AS double) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND antpsyct_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many dialysis facility cost reports were filed for fiscal 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_rnl11_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2022'
What did a typical NIH R01 research grant cost in fiscal 2024?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(total_cost AS double))) AS avg_total_cost FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' AND activity = 'R01' AND try_cast(total_cost AS double) > 0
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most granted patents?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many clinicians are affiliated with dialysis facilities?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_facility_affiliation WHERE facility_type = 'Dialysis facility'
Which federal programs accounted for the most spending in 2023 single audits?

SELECT federal_program_name, sum(try_cast(amount_expended AS double)) AS expended FROM govblock_executive.fac_federal_awards WHERE audit_year = '2023' AND federal_program_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of ChEMBL compounds break none of Lipinski's rule-of-five limits?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_compound_properties
Are EPA enforcement cases mostly administrative or judicial?
SELECT activity_type_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE activity_type_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was U.S. gross domestic product in 2024, in current dollars?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS gdp_millions FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadataa WHERE seriescode = 'A191RC' AND period = '2024'
Which states have the highest median rent?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_gross_rent FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25064' AND a.variable = 'B25064_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When does the New York grid operator's fuel mix record begin?
SELECT min(date_parse(time_stamp, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%i:%s')) AS first_reading FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix
Which major industry groups employed the most workers in December 2024?

SELECT i.industry_name, d.value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_ce_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_ce_industry i ON i.industry_code = s.industry_code WHERE s.data_type_code = '01' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND i.display_level = '2' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY try_cast(d.value AS double) DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of trademark registrations cancelled change from 2010 to 2024?
SELECT substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
What types of compliance inspection are most common under the Clean Water Act?
SELECT comp_monitor_type_desc, count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. exports went by air in 2019?

SELECT round(100.0 * max(try_cast(air_val_yr AS double)) / max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2019' AND month = '12' AND cty_name = 'TOTAL FOR ALL COUNTRIES'
Which states saw the most home loans made in 2022?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS loans FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do more inventors on U.S. applications come from Japan or from Germany?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_country_code IN ('JP', 'DE') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
